moods.mood_description: Advance the workshop frame and the historical movement of the chapter.
Show what Bengal, the troupe, or the expedition risks losing.
Expose the human cost beneath ambition, memory, or prestige.
Hold political, ethical, or interpersonal pressure in active tension.
Keep decision, movement, or revelation under strain.
Let at least one figure justify action through duty, glory, or survival.
Introduce a counter-voice that questions the obvious heroic reading.
Allow an earned emotional release without resolving every contradiction.
Hint at the next escalation in war, memory, or moral consequence.
Keep victory, devotion, or performance shadowed by cost.
